verdict.rationale: Mailchimp markets 'Generative AI features,' 'Predictive Segmentation,' and specifically 'Analytics AI' (part of Mailchimp with Intuit Intelligence) that explains which campaigns/automations drive revenue in plain language, directly matching AI-generated insights inside the product. However, evidence is mostly marketing/pricing-page claims rather than in-depth documentation of how insights surface in-product, and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of these AI features working as described. Missing for 10: detailed product docs on the Analytics AI experience, independent user validation of insight quality, and broader coverage beyond a single pricing-page bullet list.
